tools.name: browser_run
tools.description: Execute browser actions, or compile instructionText into a multi-step plan.

actions.description: List of browser actions. Supported: goto, click, type, hover, scroll, scroll_to_element, wait, key, extract_text, get_elements, click_coordinates.

tools.name: browser_summarize
tools.description: Open a web page in the browser, read its content, and return a concise summary (optionally answering a question about it).

question.description: Optional question to answer from the page

tools.name: browser_ui_audit
tools.description: Open a web page and run a UI/UX and accessibility audit (missing alt text, unlabeled inputs, heading structure, broken images, viewport/lang, console errors) with a score.

tools.name: browser_ui_fix
tools.description: Audit a built interface in a real browser, REPAIR the accessibility and usability defects in its source (alt text, labels, dead links, tap targets, document language, headings), rebuild it, and report the measured score before and after.

projectDir.description: Project folder to repair. Defaults to this session's active project.

tools.name: browser_page_fix
tools.description: Open ANY web page, measure its real UI defects (horizontal overflow, tiny tap targets, unreadable contrast, unsized/eager images), build a CSS patch that fixes them, apply it live in the browser panel so the difference is visible, measure again, and save the patch as a file.

tools.name: project_undo
tools.description: Restore a project to an earlier snapshot taken automatically before Joe changed it (undo/rollback), or list the available versions. Rebuilds after restoring.

projectDir.description: Project folder. Defaults to this session's active project.

versionId.description: Which snapshot to restore. Defaults to the most recent.

list.description: List the snapshots instead of restoring.

tools.name: project_repair
tools.description: Re-audit this session's built project in a real browser and repair what is still broken (dead images, failed requests, console errors), then rebuild and re-measure. The command behind «أصلح ما تبقّى».

request.description: The user request, retained for response language and scope.

projectDir.description: Project folder. Defaults to this session's active built project.

auditDir.description: Optional built-output folder selected from workspace evidence.

serveUrl.description: Optional live URL to audit instead of a private static preview.

artifactRootDir.description: Optional trusted artifact root used by /artifacts requests during QA.

tools.name: browser_fill_form
tools.description: Open a page and fill a form. Provide fields as { "label or name or placeholder": "value" }. Optionally submit.

fields.description: Map of field identifier (label/name/id/placeholder) to value

submit.description: Click the submit button after filling

tools.name: browser_compare
tools.description: Compare a page before/after a change: pass {before,after} URLs, or a single {url} to capture a baseline the first time and diff on the next call. Returns what was added/removed and a visual diff image + % changed.

url.description: Single URL: first call captures a baseline, next call diffs against it

tools.name: browser_extract_data
tools.description: Open a page and extract structured data (tables or lists) into JSON, and save a CSV file. Optionally pass a CSS selector.

tools.name: browser_check_links
tools.description: Open a page, collect its links, and check each for broken (4xx/5xx/unreachable) status. Returns a report of broken links.

tools.name: browser_performance
tools.description: Open a page and measure performance: load time, DOMContentLoaded, transfer size, resource counts by type, and slowest resources.

tools.name: browser_seo_audit
tools.description: Open a page and audit its SEO: title, meta description, canonical, robots, Open Graph/Twitter cards, headings, image alt coverage, and HTTPS.

tools.name: browser_console_scan
tools.description: Open a page and capture JavaScript errors, console errors/warnings, and failed network requests (4xx/5xx). Reports whether the page is error-free.

tools.name: browser_save_pdf
tools.description: Open a page and save it as a PDF file (served from /artifacts).

tools.name: browser_readability
tools.description: Open a page and extract the clean main article/content (stripping nav, ads, sidebars), with title, author, word count and reading time.

tools.name: browser_contrast_audit
tools.description: Open a page and audit text colour contrast against WCAG AA (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large). Lists low-contrast text with its ratio.

tools.name: browser_a11y_deep
tools.description: Open a page and run a deep accessibility audit: landmarks, heading order, duplicate IDs, empty/# links, positive tabindex, aria-hidden focusables, skip link, focusable count.

tools.name: browser_extract_meta
tools.description: Open a page and extract ALL metadata: title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter cards, favicon, JSON-LD structured data, and a headings outline.

tools.name: browser_translate
tools.description: Open a page, extract its readable text (title, headings, paragraphs) and translate it into a target language (default Arabic) using the LLM, with a deterministic fallback that keeps the original text.

tools.name: browser_responsive_check
tools.description: Open a page and test it across mobile / tablet / desktop viewports: captures a screenshot of each, and flags horizontal overflow, tiny tap targets, unreadable font sizes, and missing viewport meta. Returns a responsiveness score.

tools.name: browser_find_text
tools.description: Open a page and find every occurrence of a search term: returns the count, surrounding context snippets, and a screenshot with the matches highlighted.

tools.name: browser_design_tokens
tools.description: Open a page and extract its de-facto design system: dominant colours (backgrounds, text, accents/links, buttons), font families and the type scale (font sizes in use), border-radius and spacing hints — useful for auditing or redesigning the UI.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Open a page and click an element identified by visible text or a CSS selector, then report what changed (URL navigation, new content, or nothing) with a before/after screenshot.

text.description: Visible text of the element to click (button/link)

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click (alternative to text)

tools.name: browser_fullpage_shot
tools.description: Open a page and capture a full-length screenshot of the entire scrollable page (top to bottom), plus its total pixel height and a quick content summary.

tools.name: browser_smart_agent
tools.description: Autonomous multi-lens page analyst: opens a page once and gathers content summary, UI/accessibility issues, SEO/meta health, the design system (colours/fonts), responsiveness and performance signals — then returns a single consolidated, scored report with an AI executive summary.

question.description: Optional focus/question for the executive summary

tools.name: browser_autofix
tools.description: Open a page, automatically apply deterministic accessibility & SEO fixes (viewport meta, html lang, missing alt text, unlabeled inputs, single H1, meta description, empty links), then save the corrected HTML as a downloadable artifact and return before/after screenshots plus the list of fixes applied.

tools.name: browser_consent
tools.description: Ask for, or record, the user's one-time permission for Joe to use their local Chrome profile (their own logged-in account). grant=true records approval.

grant.description: true to record the user's approval

tools.name: browser_search
tools.description: Perform a web search the human way, visibly: open the search engine, move the cursor to the search box, type the query letter-by-letter in the live stream, press Enter, then read and summarise the results. Use this for "search for X", "look up X", "افتح المتصفح وابحث عن X".

query.description: What to search for (the topic only, no command words).

question.description: Optional question to answer from the results.

tools.name: browser_launch
tools.description: Open the live browser panel and navigate to a URL (or a default start page when none is given). Starts the live stream so the user watches the page load in real time. Use for "open the browser", "go to <url>", "visit <site>".

url.description: URL to open. Optional — defaults to a start page.

readContent.description: Return the visible page text after navigation.

request.description: Original user request, used for response language and evidence.

tools.name: google_account
tools.description: Act in the user's connected Google account through official APIs. actions: profile | gmail_list | gmail_read | gmail_send | calendar_list | drive_list. Requires the user to have connected Google (OAuth) first.

action.description: profile | gmail_list | gmail_read | gmail_send | calendar_list | drive_list

query.description: Gmail search query (gmail_list) or message id (gmail_read)

tools.name: user_browser
tools.description: Drive the user's OWN real browser (their logins, any website) via the installed Joe browser extension. actions: open(url) | read | screenshot | click(text|selector) | type(text) | status. Requires the user to have installed & connected the Joe extension.

action.description: open | read | screenshot | click | type | status

text.description: Text to type (type) or the visible text to click (click)

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Search the deep memory (Project Knowledge Base) for code snippets, logic, or architectural details. Use this when the user asks about something not in the current file.

query.description: The search query (e.g., "User schema definition", "Auth logic", "How X works")

limit.description: Max number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: memorize_codebase
tools.description: Scan and index the entire codebase (or a specific directory) into Deep Memory. Run this to initialize or update the memory.

directory.description: Root directory to start indexing (default: current working directory)

tools.name: repo_read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 file from the current repository using a safe relative path.

tools.name: repo_search
tools.description: Search repository files by text query with safe default ignores.

tools.name: repo_apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a conservative find/replace patch to a repository file. Supports dryRun preview.

tools.name: repo_run_command
tools.description: Run a whitelisted repository QA command such as build, test, lint, typecheck, git diff, or git status.

tools.name: repo_diff_summary
tools.description: Show a git status and diff summary for repository changes.

tools.name: architect_plan
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive architectural plan and file structure for a new feature or project.

goal.description: The high-level goal or feature description.

tools.name: ai_write_file
tools.description: Generate and write high-quality, professional file content using AI based on a description.

path.description: Destination file path relative to workspace root

description.description: Detailed description of what the file should contain

context.description: Additional technical context (e.g., framework versions, project goal)

batchId.description: Batch ID to generate (for generate_batch action)

tools.name: dependency_graph

tools.name: business_logic_parser

tools.name: ambiguity_resolver

tools.name: multi_agent_debate
tools.description: Simulate debate.

tools.name: self_confidence_evaluator
tools.description: Evaluate confidence.

focus.description: Specific element or area to focus on (optional).

tools.name: bulk_file_generator

path.description: Absolute path or relative to cwd

tools.name: validate_api

projectDescription.description: Description of the project to plan

evidence.description: Read-only engineering evidence collected from the active workspace before planning.

verificationBoundaries.description: Optional path/dependency boundaries for proportional verification

requirementsContext.description: Bounded evidence brief derived from the inspected request or specification

projectRoot.description: Evidence-backed local root selected by engineering discovery

request.description: The full project request, in the user's own words

path.description: Workspace-relative project root to operate on. Answers a select_project_root decision.

tools.name: specification_verification

specificationId.description: The ID of the specification to verify

projectRoot.description: The root directory of the built project

userId.description: The user ID for memory lookup

tools.name: enterprise_platform_foundation

request.description: The user request for the enterprise platform.

tools.name: orion_business_foundation

tools.name: project_run
tools.description: Run the built project as a LIVE server (Node/React/full-stack/static), wait until it responds, and open its live preview. Use to actually start and view a system, not just a static page.

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the active workspace root.

request.description: Description of the page/site to build

request.description: What the app is about, in the user's words

projectName.description: Canonical artifact identity supplied by the project pipeline

apiSelection.description: Trusted API selection supplied by PhaseExecutor after search_public_apis

request.description: The change, in the user's words

dir.description: Project directory (defaults to the session's active project)

tools.name: form_inbox

request.description: The user's words — usually carrying the GitHub URL

tools.name: api_project

request.description: What the API is for, in the user's words

projectName.description: Canonical artifact identity supplied by the project pipeline

skipInstall.description: Scaffold only — no npm install, no live boot proof

table.description: One table key (plants, products…). Empty means every table that has a picture column.

context.description: Words that place the subject, e.g. «مشتل نباتات».

redo.description: Replace pictures that are already there (default false).

tools.name: orders_read

tools.name: business_profile

request.description: The user's message, e.g. «احفظ بيانات عملي: الجوال 05…»

format.description: Archive format. Auto-detected from file extension if not specified.

tools.name: execute_python
tools.description: Execute a Python 3 script in an isolated environment. Use this for mathematical calculations, data analysis, file processing, JSON/CSV manipulation, or any computation where precision is critical. The script is saved to a temporary file and executed via python3. Returns stdout and stderr. Libraries like json, math, os, csv, re are available by default.

code.description: The Python 3 code to execute. Must be a complete, runnable script. Use print() to output results.

timeout.description: Max execution time in seconds. Default: 30.

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory for the script execution.

tools.name: task_lifecycle
tools.description: Manage the lifecycle of an agent task loop. Use this to update the UI with your current status, summary, and mode.

taskStatus.description: What you are doing right now (e.g. "Scanning files...")

taskSummary.description: What you have done so far.

tools.name: inspect_directory
tools.description: List directory contents in a structured JSON format (recursive supported).

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for files by name patterns (glob).

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Search for TEXT (or a regular expression) inside files in the workspace, returning file, line number and the matching line.

path.description: Directory to search (defaults to the workspace root)

regex.description: Treat the query as a regular expression

glob.description: Limit to files matching this glob (default all text files)

tools.name: inspect_symbol
tools.description: Extract the code definition of a specific Class or Function by name.

tools.name: file_edit_advanced
tools.description: Advanced file editing with multiple non-contiguous replacements.

tools.name: notify_user
tools.description: Send a non-blocking progress update to the user's chat UI. Unlike `echo`, this does NOT stop your autonomous execution loop. Use this to keep the user informed about intermediate steps (e.g. "Installing dependencies…", "Running tests…"). Use `echo` ONLY for the final concluding message.

message.description: The progress update message to display to the user. Keep it concise and informative.

level.description: Severity level of the notification. Default: info.

tools.name: payments_create_checkout_session
tools.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session for payment processing. Requires Stripe API key to be configured.

productName.description: Name of the product or service being purchased

successUrl.description: URL to redirect after successful payment

cancelUrl.description: URL to redirect if payment is cancelled

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description: Proactively create and manage a structured task list for your current coding session. This helps track progress, organize complex tasks, and demonstrate thoroughness to the user.

merge.description: If true, existing todos not in this list will be preserved. If false, the entire list is replaced.

todos.description: Array of todo items to write to the workspace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the todo item

status.description: The current status of the todo item

content.description: The description/content of the todo item

workspaceId.description: The current workspace ID to target the UI update.
